R01.instruction: Change her white top to a dark green top.
R01.must_change: the white top she is wearing becomes dark green
must_not_change: her face and identity (features, expression, skin tone)

R05.instruction: Add a grey cat sleeping on the sofa.
R05.must_change: a grey cat lies asleep on the sofa
must_not_change: the sofa's shape and light-blue colour
the framed picture on the wall
the wooden floor and the walls

R09.instruction: Replace the pink dragon fruits with green apples. Do not change anything else.
R09.must_change: the pile of pink dragon fruits becomes a pile of green apples
must_not_change: the mangoes, oranges, avocados, grapes and the other fruit piles
the ground and the scene layout

R11.instruction: Change the red wine in the glass to white wine.
R11.must_change: the wine in the glass is a pale white wine, still transparent
must_not_change: the glass's shape, rim and reflections
the red glass stem and the foot
R11.what: wine in the bowl of the glass

R12.instruction: Remove the man in dark clothes walking towards the camera in the middle of the street.
R12.must_change: that man is gone; the wet pavement and the people behind him are plausibly filled in
must_not_change: the "MATHEW STREET - BIRTHPLACE of THE BEATLES" banner and its lettering
the "Quarry Quarter" and other shop signs
the wet reflections and the night lighting
R12.what: the man walking towards the camera
text_elements_to_protect: the banner hung across the street (two lines of lettering, round logos at both ends)
the pink half-disc hanging sign at the upper left (two words)
the small green sign on the brick wall (two lines)
the purple shopfront fascia lettering at the left edge, and the pink round sign with a letter below it
the signs at the right edge (the tall vertical sign; the red fascia above the lit window)

R15.instruction: Paint the brick wall around the shop white. Keep the shop sign and all lettering exactly as they are.
R15.must_change: the brick facade around the shop becomes white-painted brick
must_not_change: the "Beguiling" sign and all its lettering and artwork
the window displays, posters and the lettering on the glass
R15.what: facade edit; preserve = sign + shop windows + door
text_elements_to_protect: the large shop sign above the windows (the main word and the small word beside it)
the white banner at the top of the right-hand window (two lines)
the number in the speech-bubble decal at the top of the door glass
the poster on the lower door panel (several lines)
the small round red sticker on the door glass

R02.instruction: Remove the dark grey van parked in front of the building.
R02.must_change: the van is gone; the pavement, street and building base behind it are plausibly filled in
must_not_change: the building facade, windows and balcony
the red no-entry sign and its pole
the blue street-name sign on the wall
text_elements_to_protect: the blue street-name sign on the wall above the van (white lettering, three lines)
the small white plate under the red no-entry sign (one word above two bicycle pictograms)
